description: The Process Mining Flow Visual brings approval workflow analysis directly into Power BI. Map any sequential process — from initiation through closure — as a vertical flow diagram with connected stages. Each stage displays case counts and average durations, helping operations teams instantly identify where work slows down. Use the Expand By field to break each stage down by approver, owner, or any categorical dimension, surfacing exactly who is holding up a process and for how long. Navigate large workflows with built-in zoom controls and toggle between vertical and horizontal orientations to fit your report layout. Designed for enterprise and government tasker management workflows, this visual is ideal for any team that needs to understand process velocity, bottlenecks, and approver accountability in a single view.
